result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where delivery time and delivery fee text overlap beneath the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements overlap each other, making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee in a proper inline flex or text container with a separator dot and spacing (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') instead of overlapping absolute or miscalculated positions.
